value: /sorted, on Akien's ruling — decisions/2026-08-10-clearance-is-mandatory. Drained from troubles/every-crossing-goes-around-the-clearance-gate.json per the 2026-08-02 three-entry-points ruling ('troubles/ is a pre-ticket inbox, not a parallel place work lives; a trouble that never becomes a ticket is a bug with no workflow').

The ruling's immediate half is DONE at cast, not deferred to the build: the four present-tense sites in cairn/tools/base/transitions.py that claimed the clearance gate wraps emit (the module docstring's AUTHORITY line, the build-gate note, _build_gate's provenance, and emit's own docstring) now state that it does not, carry the 2026-08-10 measurement, and name this ticket. cairn/devices/harbor_master/intention+why.json is conformed too: its falsifier records that it is MET and that the code must move to meet the sentence rather than the sentence soften, and how_it_learns retracts a claim that the learning precondition was met — zero crossings have ever been cleared, so the honest reason the learner is deferred is that NO fleet moves through the gate, not that too few do.

2026-08-10, BEFORE the chart chain ran — so the chain could not template-fill from a dead premise. THE FINDING: three of this ticket's four presumed blockers were already dissolved on disk at cast time, and the cast named them anyway. (i) MethodRegistry HAS NOT EXISTED SINCE 2026-08-05 — measured by grep across both repos: every surviving mention is a past-tense reference in prose (clearance.py's own NO REGISTRY header, validation_store.py:60/173, quorum.py:144) plus the three stale sites in this ticket and its parent trouble. clearance.py:264 calls validation_store.standing(proven_by), one file read at an address derived from the proof's path. So falsifier clause (4), assumption (3)'s second half, and child (a)'s second half were all describing a component that had been removed. (ii) THE EXEMPTION ROSTER IS NOT AN INVENTION — transitions.py:533 already holds `_EXEMPT_ROSTER`, empty by design and structural ahead of any entry, keyed by component and consulted only in _require_named_ticket. Child (b) composes it rather than building one. (iii) The corrections are marked IN PLACE with the word CORRECTED/HALVED/NARROWED and the superseded text quoted, never silently swapped — a stale premise that vanishes without a trace is indistinguishable from one that was never there. HOW IT HAPPENED, because that is the reusable part: the cast copied a paragraph forward from the trouble file, and the trouble file contains BOTH the old blocker text AND, later in the same field, the 2026-08-05 sharpening that dissolves it. The newer sentence did not overwrite the older one; they sit in one string, and the cast read the top of it. WHAT DID NOT CHANGE: the intention, the why, the priority, the falsifier's DONE condition, and clauses (1)(2)(3)(5). The measured claim this ticket exists to close — 186 emit-shaped records, ZERO carrying cleared_by — is untouched and re-runnable.

PROVED at cairn/tools/base/history.json seq 36 (2026-08-10T16:55:29), the crossing carrying all six gate notes — exit_gate, clearance_gate, emission_gate and deposit_enqueued on one record. THE NUMBER MOVED OFF ZERO: every denominator ever taken of this corpus read 0 cleared crossings (0 of 146 at the trouble, 0 of 186 at cast, 0 of 189 at survey); it now reads 2 of 193, and both are this voyage's own. The verdict artifact is verdict-20260810T165443-2fd30b21c0ef.json — 7 criteria pass, 12 hypotheses dispositioned, 4 of them KILLED.

THE DISTINCTIONS WORTH THE YEAR THEY COST:

(1) THE RUNG WAS UNCALLABLE, NOT UNUSED. clear() had no production caller since 2026-07-29 because three gates inside emit read journal_extra['ticket'] and clear() accepted no **journal_extra — a caller doing everything right was refused with TicketRequiredRed. A year of ambient crossings was physics pointing the wrong way, and nothing said so because nobody was calling it to find out. THE GENERAL FORM: a rung with zero callers is a measurement of its callability before it is a measurement of anyone's discipline.

(2) AFFORDABILITY IS ANSWERED BY A RULE ABOUT THE CROSSING, NEVER A LIST OF COMPONENTS. The demanded set is a forward journaled crossing INTO A REST (not is_summons(target)) — the move that enters proven-space, which is exactly the move clear() already knows how to judge and which /sail seals one step earlier at PROVEME. _CLEARANCE_EXEMPT_ROSTER is therefore EMPTY in production and this ticket's own PROVED crossing CLEARED rather than being waived through: falsifier clause (1) avoided by scope, not by discipline. The 74 stale seals that would have forced a waiver list left as their own cast ticket (the-corpus-is-out-of-proven-space, re-measured 6 of 78 at the close, with the four TRAIL-INTEGRITY failures broken out so a re-seal sweep cannot make them look answered).

(3) TWO OWNERSHIPS SHARED ONE WORD, AND THE LIVE FIRE FOUND IT. boat_owner was settled from Law 6 as 'the component whose history is appended' ('base'); the first real clear() call refused — "Unauthorized: 'CC' may not move boat 'emit-refuses-an-uncleared-crossing' to 'WATCHME': not its owner ('base')" — because the gate compares boat_owner against ACTOR. The component owns its history FILE; the boat's owner is a MOVER. Corrected at the owner's address with the superseded answer kept beside it. THE FIX BEING 'type a different string' IS THE FINDING: the caller supplies BOTH sides of the identity the gate checks, so the Law 6 refusal binds an honest caller and nothing else, and the grant path does not rescue it (Grant.authorizes() checks by_owner == owner against the same caller-supplied string). Cast as boat_owner-is-read-not-stated (P1, harbor_master) rather than absorbed.

(4) A VOYAGE'S PROVED CROSSING CANNOT BE THE FIRST CROSSING IT CLEARS. The exit gate refuses a claimed ticket's PROVED crossing without a complete verdict artifact, so the verdict citing PROVED would have to precede PROVED. The first cleared crossing in the system's life is therefore this voyage's WATCHME one (seq 35) — which is NOT in the demanded set at all (WATCHME is a summons) and carries the witness only because clear() stamps every move it clears. The chart chain predicted PROVED and was wrong about the ordering; the kill is recorded in the verdict rather than smoothed.

(5) THE HOLLOW TOOTH WAS CAUGHT BY THE REVERT CYCLE, NOT BY ASSERTION. Reverting 'a caller may hand the harbor its own witness' left its tooth GREEN: a broad 'except TypeError: pass' swallowed the very refusal it meant to assert. Rebuilt until the revert turned it red. The other three reverts bit on the first try. Law 8 held because the cycle was RUN, and a verdict claiming the cycle had been performed would have shipped this tooth empty.

WHAT IS STILL RED, NAMED: the authority half of the rung binds only an honest caller until boat_owner is read from the boat (boat_owner-is-read-not-stated). The corpus count is 2 — n=2 by one hand, which is why harbor_master's how_it_learns still declines to harvest. The probe clearance_actually_gates stands armed at cairn/devices/harbor_master/probes/, born quiet (demanded_total 0 above its era floor at arming), watching for the three ways this can still fail silently: a bypassed crossing, a roster that grows to cover the fleet, and a gate that never once says no.

P0 — From a LIVE trouble whose condition is MET and GROWING — 146 uncleared crossings at 2026-08-05, 186 at 2026-08-10, four of them added by CC during the measuring session itself. A component's own stated falsifier is met continuously and the corpus reads green because nothing derives red (Law 9). It is P0 rather than P1 because every day it stands, the false claim in transitions.py teaches the next reader — and the next builder — that an authority gate runs where none does.

value.a: Three assumptions were load-bearing and are now named rather than carried. (1) THAT THE RECORDS ARE WRONG — they are not. Every one of the 186 uncleared crossings was made by the box's single owner, so nothing improper was ever authorized; what is false is the CLAIM, restated in four sites in transitions.py, that a gate stands between a caller and a record of truth. This ticket fixes a lie about physics, not a breach. (2) THAT 'MANDATORY' MEANS EVERY CROSSING — it cannot, because the gate has to be crossed into existence and the first crossing cannot be cleared by a gate that is not yet running. The bootstrap exemption is therefore a REQUIRED part of the build, and it must be a NAMED roster entry, not an accident of ordering. (3) THAT CLEARANCE'S ARGUMENTS ARE ANSWERABLE TODAY — they are not, and this is the real cost. clear() demands actor, boat_id, boat_owner and proven_by; for the crossings we actually make the mover is CC and the 'method' a PROVED crossing summons is arguably the component's own proof. CORRECTED 2026-08-10: this assumption continued 'MethodRegistry is in-memory with NO production register() call, so a naive wiring would re-run a proof under the tester at every crossing. That is why this is cast and not built in the same act.' Both sentences were FALSE ON THE DAY THEY WERE WRITTEN — the registry was removed five days earlier, and the trouble file this cast drained from already recorded the removal and said in terms that 'the blocker above dissolves with it'. The stale text was carried forward from the trouble's OLDER paragraph. What survives is only the first half: the four field values are genuinely unsettled, and that is child (a).

One point was asserted-wrapped and is not, and it is recorded as child (a) rather than smuggled past: what a crossing's actor / boat_owner / proven_by ARE for a CC-made crossing is UNANSWERED, and it is the gating question — the door cannot refuse an uncleared crossing until there is a legal way to clear one. A second is genuinely open and is child (c): whether emit refuses on a MISSING cleared_by or on a FAILED clearance is not the same door, and the trouble's own text asks it ('the ticket's first question is whether emit's journal path should refuse a crossing that carries no cleared_by'). Everything else is wrapped: the ruling is recorded and verifiable, the measurement is re-runnable, the four false prose sites are already corrected as the ruling's immediate conformance, and the falsifier below is stated against a condition that is currently MET, so the ticket starts red by measurement and not by convention.

No exclusive-and-terminal collision; two distinctions to record, both checked over the whys. (1) tickets/clearance-leaves-a-trace (cast 2026-07-26, at BUILDME) — its why is that a clearance REQUEST and a REFUSAL must leave a trace owned by the gate's queue, because today the gate writes nothing until it GRANTS. That is about the gate's own record-keeping; this ticket is about whether the gate runs at all. They are not exclusive — they are SEQUENCED, and in a direction worth naming: clearance-leaves-a-trace is currently unreachable, because a gate with no callers has no requests and no refusals to trace. This ticket unblocks it, and its trace is what would make this ticket's own horizon countable. (2) harbor_master's charter (cairn/devices/harbor_master/intention+why.json) declares a wrong-intent signal — 'if devices advance workflows AROUND it once the clearance gate lands (ambient transitions), the authority rung has failed (Law 6)'. That is not a collision: it is this ticket's parent condition, met continuously since 2026-07-21, and the charter was conformed to say so in the same act as this cast. The congruency-lab consult (recompiled 2026-08-10 before this cast) surfaced no third intention claiming authority over transitions.
